status: CONTACT-SYNCHRONIZED REFERENCE IMPLEMENTED; timbres remain sketches pending speaker review
scope: Basic nonverbal gel/material and attention SFX. No voice, recorded mumble, ElevenLabs, background music or remote API.

seededVariation.timing: Choose visible contact patterns first. Never move sounds away from contacts merely for randomness.

mix.attention: Every new request/outcome only once; variation changes never replay ding. Volume zero silences all.

settled.character: Soft, airy little gel movements; comfy can have one tiny settling plop; bored is quieter, not a failure cue.

energy.character: Slow deflating squish, never a medical/battery alarm; tired/exhausted routines mostly silent.

joy.character: Round buoyant plops and quick tiny elastic chirps; excited brighter, not continuously louder.

cognition.character: Precise small contacts; one investigative wobble, typing when the desk really moves.

confidence.character: Firm clean contact and self-satisfied settling wobble; no spoken laugh or human voice.

social.character: Soft hesitant squish/peek with long spaces; no guilt-provoking cries.

frustration.character: Compact lower squish/firm contact; greater visual force, not a drum soundtrack or abusive noise.

sadness.character: Low soft squish; occasional tear plip at visible landing, no sob recording or constant water loop.

alarm.character: Short elastic recoil/airy tremble, not a security siren; frightened uses unresolved fictional context only.

surprise.character: One tiny pop then silence; freeze face carries the beat.

recovery.character: Settling gel exhale/plop; hopeful stays light, relieved softens.

strain.character: Uneven little strained squish, not harsh distortion; overload is mainly visual.

recipes.cue: One major rebound, not every oscillation
Selected key contact, not all keys
Surface contact(s), then stable two-note alert
A big finish's reveal: a size above small
One alert reveal per request; invariant notes
An idle sneeze's lurch; sounds with the routine chance
A snore's soft breath while asleep; sounds with the routine chance
